ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question-2
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: "Blowing sand to fill the sea" refers to enclosing a certain area of sea with sandbags, then using pressure pumps and pipelines to "blow" the seabed sediment and seawater outside the enclosure together into the enclosure; the seawater flows out of the enclosure, and the sediment deposits inside the enclosure, silting up to become land. On the northwest shore of Bohai Bay, the area of land formed by blowing sand at Caofeidian Port and Industrial Zone reaches 310km2, with an average sea-filling depth of 4.6m. Answer the following questions. <image1> According to the above GIS flowchart, which item of area information about the land reclamation process on the northwest shore of Bohai Bay can be obtained by using this GIS system?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: Area of the land reclamation zone.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the GIS process in the figure, on the left are multi-source basic maps, including topographic maps, administrative divisions, nautical charts, etc., which undergo processing such as isobaths and land-sea boundary lines and graphic correction; on the right are RS images from 1994—2010, which after image processing yield coastline data from 1994—2010. method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的流程：多源基础图件和1994—2010年遥感影像经处理后得到海岸线数据，并通过GIS空间分析输出填海造陆进程。再读题干要求“哪一项面积信息”。在该流程能反映的填海造陆进程中，与面积对应的不是植被类型或土地利用类型，也不是海岸线长度，而是填海形成陆地区域的面积，因此答“填海造陆区面积”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中的GIS流程左侧是多源基础图件，包括地形图、行政区划、海图等，经等深线、海陆边界线等处理并进行图形校正；右侧是1994—2010年RS影像，经图像处理后得到1994—2010年海岸线数据。两部分数据共同进入“GIS空间分析”，最后输出“填海造陆进程”。再推理：题目问利用该GIS系统能得到填海造陆进程的哪一项“面积信息”。流程主要反映海岸线变化和填海造陆范围变化，因此与面积对应的是填海形成陆地区域的面积，而不是植被类型、土地利用类型或海岸线长度。

根据上述GIS流程图，利用此GIS系统能得到渤海湾西北岸填海造陆进程的哪一项面积信息？
raw_record.answer: Area of the land reclamation zone.
